article.headline: Dinkins scores 23 in Manhattan's 74-64 victory against Mount St. Mary's
article.description: — Devin Dinkins scored 23 points as Manhattan beat Mount St. Mary's 74-64 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Dinkins scores 23 in Manhattan's 74-64 victory against Mount St. Mary's

categories.description: Manhattan Jaspers @ Mount St. Mary's Mountaineers

event.description: Manhattan Jaspers @ Mount St. Mary's Mountaineers

keywords: Manhattan Jaspers @ Mount St. Mary's Mountaineers
article.story: EMMITSBURG, Md. -- — Devin Dinkins scored 23 points as Manhattan beat Mount St. Mary's 74-64 on Saturday night. Dinkins shot 5 for 14 (3 for 7 from 3-point range) and 10 of 11 from the free-throw line for the Jaspers (9-9, 4-5 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Masiah Gilyard scored 12 points while going 4 of 5 and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line and added 13 rebounds. Shaquil Bender shot 5 for 19, including 2 for 10 from beyond the arc to finish with 12 points. The Mountaineers (11-9, 4-5) were led by Dola Adebayo, who posted 20 points and seven rebounds. Mount St. Mary's also got 13 points from Dallas Hobbs. Carmelo Pacheco also recorded eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
